notes.title: HIGHER GROUND Release Date : 25th July!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, and welcome!

Finally, HIGHER GROUND release is very close, 25th, July!  
Don't forget! We will hold a launch discount for a week!

HIGHER GROUND :
- has an amazing and touching story.
- will give you the pleasure of Flying and Jumping over the city.
- is a 3D racing-like adventure game.
- will test your 3D-driving skill, agility and judgment.

I hope you have a very good time playing the game.

Thank you for your time and interest in HIGHER GROUND.
